title: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
reason: Dutch central bank license for MiCA-compliant euro settlement backed by BBVA, BNP Paribas, and ING is a significant regulatory and infrastructure milestone with two sources.

sources.summary: Backed by BBVA, BNP Paribas, and ING, Qivalis secured Dutch regulatory authorization to offer onchain euro settlement infrastructure.
Qivalis said the Electronic Money Institution authorization enables it to launch a euro-denominated stablecoin, with issuance planned for the coming months, subject to additional MiCA requirements.

title: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
reason: Standard Chartered offering direct BTC and ETH trading to UAE clients is a major bank adoption milestone, corroborated by two sources.

sources.summary: The bank manages custody and settlement in-house via a closed-loop model, removing the need for separate crypto wallets.
Standard Chartered expanded its spot crypto trading services to professional investors in the UAE region, with plans to offer access to more market participants.
